flows.observation: Current serializable transaction saves RequirementEntity updates and RequirementsRecoveryRunEntity replay hash/result together, with same-key replay/conflict and unique-race handling.
flows.boundary: Authored requirements and operational recovery receipts separate. Preserve exact payload/receipt binding and all-or-nothing item graph; prove crash/replay recovery without claiming cross-store atomicity.

flows.observation: Fresh DI scopes obtain McpDbContext and override host workspace identity. TODO create/update/delete save children/links plus audit. Link synchronization may revive or create requirement placeholders. File projection and success/failure markers are later operations.
flows.boundary: Resolve immutable project/branch at each fresh scope and compensation. Keep authored graph and valid links under owner gate; audit/projection markers operational. Do not treat projection failure as rollback, repeat audit/version increments or unconditional resurrection of retired requirements.

flows.observation: Add/update save content first, append MemoryVersion in another save, then attempt operational session logging. Revert saves content and a version together. Scope can be changed by update; EmbeddingStatus is mixed with authored content.
flows.boundary: Preserve complete content/version graph, route scope/status/session fields explicitly, and prove restart at each save boundary. Scope movement and version parent ownership cannot be inferred from an ID or a whole-table rule.

flows.observation: Workspace creation saves host registry then invokes explicit dump import inside a current database transaction. Wiki import directly adds TODO/link projections and may copy a YAML archive.
flows.boundary: Enrolled projects use approved explicit import/migration and owner gate. Preserve standalone behavior and original archive data. Host registry transaction cannot imply a distributed project/control transaction or complete all-domain migration.

flows.observation: Memory, session and tool compensation directly query a DbContext with soft-delete visibility, restore fields/graphs and save. Session compensation uses its current DB transaction.
flows.boundary: Compensation must use the original operation context and owning gate, never whichever branch is active later. Raw session/tool data stay operational; Workspace-memory restoration preserves authored graph and scoped identity. Current exact-helper naming does not prove full new projection coverage.

flows.observation: Existing state adapters directly save memory, requirement and session rows, and may invoke selected services. These paths implement legacy command/state replay.
flows.boundary: Keep legacy standalone/non-enrolled behavior. Do not execute legacy replay for an enrolled versioned project or replay incoming merged data through business commands/external effects. Old queue/conflict/operation records require explicit retained disposition at cutover.

flows.observation: An automatic UpdatedAtUtc candidate belongs to the encrypted GitHub token JSON file, not an EF row.
flows.boundary: Protected host-local token file and Data Protection remain outside project history/export. Syntax assignment matches alone cannot identify database writes or safe content.

limitations: Selected source boundaries, not full dynamic caller/semantic closure
Current single-context transactions do not prove future project/control atomicity
No product execution, database read/write, migration or administrative command
No requirements or approved plan amendment; task design remains proposed
